title: Split frontend JavaScript filter runtime
description: Refactor assets/js/eit-frontend.js into bounded runtime modules for state, matching, URL sync, rendering updates, and UI interactions.
objective: Reduce the 845-line frontend runtime before adding richer filter behavior.
acceptance_criteria: No public data attributes or selectors are renamed.
Each frontend JS module stays below the plugin line budget.
verification: Frontend smoke check passes for search, range, options, sort, reset, and pagination where available.
php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict passes or reports only tracked transition debt.

budgets.context_budget: frontend JS and widget markup contracts

risks: Filter state can desync from URL parameters if split incorrectly.
DOM selectors can drift from rendered widget markup.
Runtime behavior may need broader manual QA once interactions multiply.
